question: How does Brand Visibility use Google Search Console and GA4 data for AI search visibility?
approach: Search Console queries suggest prompts to track (a person picks them; none are added automatically), and Google Analytics 4 can fill the Business Impact tab, as CJA or Adobe Analytics can. Both connect with a Google sign-in.

question: How does Sites Optimizer use Google Search Console data for SEO opportunities?
approach: Sites Optimizer has its own Search Console connection, set up as part of Sites Optimizer's setup.

question: How does Edge Delivery publish pages from SharePoint and Google Drive document authoring?
approach: Authors write pages in Word or Google Docs in your SharePoint or Google Drive, and Edge Delivery publishes them as pages. This applies only when you authors in documents; with Experience Workspace or AEM Sites, authoring stays in Adobe.

question: How does Sites Optimizer fix content authored in SharePoint or Google Docs documents?
approach: For eligible opportunities, Sites Optimizer writes approved fixes back into the source documents using that opportunity's documented route; authors review and publish them from Sidekick. SharePoint on your own domain needs an app registration with site write access; Google Drive needs a folder share with Editor access.

question: How does Brand Concierge answer from a website on another CMS such as WordPress or Sitecore?
approach: Brand Concierge runs on any site through your tag manager or page templates, and reads the site as a knowledge source. Adobe calls deployment a short, one-time configuration for each site.

question: How do AEM Assets digital asset management images get delivered on Edge Delivery pages?
approach: Edge Delivery Services is part of AEM, and AEM Sites can be its content source: pages are managed in the Sites console, edited in the Universal Editor and published from AEM to Edge Delivery, and AEM Sites and Edge Delivery pages can share one domain. When every page runs on Edge Delivery, take the Site build with components and templates service out on the AEM Sites card.

Authors keep AEM Sites tools such as workflows, multi-site management, translation and launches (with the Universal Editor extensions enabled), visitors get fast Edge Delivery pages, and both can run on one domain during a phased move with CDN routing rules (the AEM publish and Edge Delivery on one domain service, under More services on this card).

question: How does Adobe Commerce use AEM Assets digital asset management for product images?
approach: The AEM Assets Integration for Commerce links approved AEM Assets to Commerce products by SKU, or by custom matching built in Adobe Developer App Builder, and syncs them into the catalog; merchandisers can also pick DAM assets inside the Commerce Admin. On Commerce on Cloud and on-premises it's an Adobe extension we install; on Commerce as a Cloud Service it's configured in the Commerce Admin.
Merchandisers manage product images once in AEM Assets; approved images tagged with SKUs reach Commerce products, most within five minutes, keeping storefronts accurate and on brand.
